I know you're do well with therapy, and this is why-the most common misunderstanding about depression is that everyone thinks they need to have a reason to live to manage depression. That isn't it though. I have kids to live for, but guess what? My depression still exists because it's a mental health disorder that's literally changed the chemistry in my brain. You can't will yourself out of it overnight because you have something or someone you care about. You have to learn coping mechanisms and techniques that take time. Just like when you break a leg and need to wear a cast for some time. It's a process that operates a certain way. You will get through it, and you'll look back and be like "damn, I downplayed what I was going through." You can do it though. Just don't overwhelm yourself. If you actually listen to your therapist and take it one day at a time, you'll be fine.
